Development of machine learning models to identify potentially active compounds against tuberculosis.

results.scope: Screening on the labelled sample, not search exhaustiveness. Uncertain counts as incorrect for strict accuracy and is retained for retention recall.
results.timing_scope: Same-scope per-record screening only; machine time includes cached reviewer calls where recorded. Human verification time for the final manuscript is separate.

limitations: Three-record convenience sample; cannot estimate performance across the full corpus.
Human labels concern thematic title/abstract eligibility, not full-text eligibility or correctness of extracted evidence.
Uncertain predictions count as incorrect under strict accuracy; they are not scientific exclusions.
The approximately 120-second human total is an estimate, not a controlled timing baseline. No per-record manual times or time-saving claim are supplied.
